title: Extended DNA binding interface beyond the canonical SAP domain contributes to SDE2 function at DNA replication forks
authors: Alexandra S. Weinheimer; YiTing Paung; Julie Rageul; Arafat Khan; Brian Ho; Michael Tong; Sébastien Alphonse; Markus A. Seeliger; Hyungjin Kim
one_liner_zh: 该文通过NMR结构解析和突变实验表征SDE2的SAP结构域与ssDNA的扩展结合界面，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作的结构与功能研究，但缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，且非典型TF-DNA体系。
abstract: Elevated DNA replication stress causes instability of the DNA replication fork and DNA mutations, which underlies tumorigenesis. The DNA replication stress regulator SDE2 binds to TIMELESS (TIM) of the fork protection complex (FPC) and enhances its stability, thereby supporting replisome activity at DNA replication forks. Here, we structurally and functionally characterize a new conserved DNA binding motif related to SAP ( S AF-A/B, A cinus, P IAS) in human SDE2 and establish its preference for single-stranded DNA (ssDNA). The nuclear magnetic resonance solution structure of SDE2 SAP reveals a helix-extended loop-helix core aligned parallel to each other, consistent with known canonical SAP folds. Notably, its DNA interaction extends beyond the core SAP domain and is augmented by two lysine residues in the C-terminal tail, which is uniquely positioned adjacent to SAP and conserved in the pre-mRNA splicing factor SF3A3. Mutation in the SAP domain with extended C-terminus not only disrupts ssDNA binding but also impairs TIM localization at replication forks, thus inhibiting efficient fork progression. Together, our study establishes SDE2 SAP as an essential element for SDE2 to exert its role in preserving replication fork integrity via FPC regulation and highlights the structural diversity of the DNA-protein interactions achieved by a specialized DNA binding motif.
abstract_zh: DNA复制压力升高导致DNA复制叉不稳定和DNA突变，这是肿瘤发生的根本原因。DNA复制压力调控因子SDE2与叉保护复合物（FPC）的TIMELESS（TIM）结合并增强其稳定性，从而支持复制叉处的复制体活性。在此，我们从结构和功能上表征了人类SDE2中一个与SAP（SAF-A/B、Acinus、PIAS）相关的新型保守DNA结合基序，并确定其对单链DNA（ssDNA）的偏好性。SDE2 SAP的核磁共振溶液结构揭示了一个螺旋-延伸环-螺旋核心，彼此平行排列，与已知的典型SAP折叠一致。值得注意的是，其DNA相互作用延伸至核心SAP结构域之外，并由C末端尾部的两个赖氨酸残基增强，该尾部独特地邻近SAP定位，并在前体mRNA剪接因子SF3A3中保守。SAP结构域及其延伸C末端的突变不仅破坏ssDNA结合，还损害复制叉处TIM的定位，从而抑制有效的叉进展。总之，我们的研究确立了SDE2 SAP作为SDE2通过FPC调控维持复制叉完整性的关键元件，并突显了由特化DNA结合基序实现的DNA-蛋白质相互作用的多样性。
